22840.overview:
Press 1 on the alpha-numeric keyboard.

A full size tournament soccer table appears on your screen. The scoring rack is at the bottom.

The left hand control controls the goalkeeper at the left side of the screen and the other members of the team who wear the same colors.

The right-hand control controls the goalkeeper on the right side of the screen, as well as the other members of the team.

You can play against another player or the computer. Press the action button or move the joystick of the hand control to tell the computer how many people are in the game. If one of the hand controls is not activated, the computer will play that side and a "C" will appear on the scoring rack. If neither hand control is activated, the computer will play itself.

Each joystick controls three sets of electronic lightning rods that maneuver the ranks of players.

Push the joystick of the left-hand control to the left to control the goalkeeper. When the joystick is in the center position, it will control the center file of three team members. When the joystick is in the far right position, it will control the file of two team members on the right side of your screen. For the right-hand control, the reverse is true.

The ball will come into play from the bottom of the screen.

The ball will stop when it hits a player and the joystick is controlling the player's row. To kick, press the action button and simultaneously move the joystick in the direction you wish the ball to go.

The ball will rebound off a player whose row is not under control of the joystick.

When a goal is scored, a ring will slide along the scoring rack at the bottom of the screen. /=1 point. X=2 points.

The game ends when one of the teams scores ten points. XXXXX=10 points.

To play again, press the RESET key on the alphanumeric keyboard and then press 1.

22900.overview:
"The Quest for the Rings" is a hybrid board and video game released for the Magnavox Odyssey² as part of the Master Strategy series. In this fantasy adventure, players embark on a mission to recover ten lost rings from a world filled with danger and magic. Players can choose to play as a Warrior, Wizard, Phantom, or Changeling, each with unique abilities. The game combines strategic planning on a physical game board with action-packed sequences on the video screen.

Players move their characters across the board, facing different challenges and monsters in various dungeons and landscapes. When encountering an enemy or entering a dungeon, the game transitions to the video screen where players must navigate and combat foes in real-time. The objective is to collect all ten rings while surviving the perils of each level. The game encourages cooperative play, requiring teamwork to overcome obstacles and complete the quest​
